site.name: Hilltide
site.description: A live, real-time 3D story of Rwanda and Kigali: the land, the city growing from 2016 to 2023, and where rain flows across the hills. Computed in your browser from open data.
site.noscript: Hilltide is a live 3D experience and needs JavaScript to run.
placeholder.body: The land, the city and the rain arrive here in stages. Nothing will be pre-recorded: every frame is computed in your browser from open data.
placeholder.acts: Three acts: The Land. Kigali Builds Itself. Make It Rain.
